videos.title: YouTube video or podcast URLs
videos.description: Long YouTube videos or podcasts to analyse. Shorts usually have little or no Most Replayed data.

maxVideos.title: Max videos
maxVideos.description: Cap on videos processed (and charged) in this run.

maxMoments.title: Max moments per video
maxMoments.description: Maximum clip timestamps returned per video, ranked by score.

clipSeconds.title: Suggested clip length (seconds)
clipSeconds.description: Suggested clip window around each moment, in seconds.

maxComments.title: Comments to scan per video
maxComments.description: Used to find timestamps viewers mention (e.g. 3:21).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many videos to analyse in parallel (1–6).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube often blocks cloud IPs (LOGIN_REQUIRED). Leave the default Apify datacenter proxy on for platform runs. Do not enable residential groups unless a run is still blocked.
